job.job_description:
Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to deliver and iterate on AI capabilities with measurable business value.
Document system architectures, deployment procedures, and operational runbooks for maintainability and knowledge transfer.
Additional Valued Skills Full-Stack Development & Deployment
The following are not primary requirements but are considered strong differentiators. Candidates with exposure or working knowledge in these areas will be preferred:
Build or contribute to front-end interfaces for AI agent assets using modern JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks (React, Next.js, or equivalent).
Develop backend APIs and services using Python (FastAPI, Flask) and/or Node.js (Express) to serve AI capabilities to end users.
Work with relational databases (SQL Server, PostgreSQL) and integrate with vector databases for hybrid data needs.
Support containerized deployment with Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and environment setup across development, staging, and production.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or related field.
3-7 years of relevant experience in software development, machine learning, analytics, or AI solution development.
Strong Python skills and working knowledge of SQL.
Experience building and deploying AI/ML solutions.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized deployment workflows.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder communication skills.
Note: This role requires hands-on software engineering and system-building skills. Candidates whose experience is limited to prompt engineering, no-code/low-code AI tools, or AI wrapper applications without underlying engineering depth will not be considered.
